headline: Stonecradle Clashes Reignite As Bitter Fighting Churns Northern Sectors
war_summary: Frontline turnover has shifted sharply back into Stonecradle, logging six base transitions over the past two hours centered on World's End and The Reach following an earlier lull. Bitter fighting persists at fever pitch across Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line, where combined casualty rates exceed two thousand men per hour and strategic positions continue to trade hands, most notably around Wightwalk, Blinding Stones, and Blackcoat Way. In contrast, direct base transfers have paused across Linn of Mercy and Mooring County over the latest two-hour window, though combat in both sectors remains ferocious, with Mooring County recording over two thousand casualties in the last hour alone. Further inland, Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow, and Dead Lands maintain steady attritional pressure without yielding fresh base movements, while rearward provinces remain entirely undisturbed.
